name: Dynamic Tab Pills
description: Row of toggleable pill tabs where adjacent active pills merge into one joined shape with a thin separator line between them.
contents: Row of pill buttons built from a list of labels
behavior: Clicking a pill toggles it active or idle, multiple can be active
Adjacent active pills overlap and join, with a separator that scales in
Font size drops to 10px on screens 600px and below, row scrolls horizontally if too wide
editableByProps: Pill labels, initially active pills, font size
Background, fill, border, hover, separator and text colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the pill corner radius of joined pills

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Renders nothing until mounted on the client
